items.text: Critics attribute the decline to weaker demand rather than to new technology, which they maintain has been overstated.
items.prompt: which 指的是什么？主句在主张什么？

choices.label: which = new technology；主句把下降归因于需求变弱
choices.why: rather than 后面的 new technology 是最近、也说得通的先行词；they maintain 是插入的主张。

choices.label: which = the decline；主句在夸新技术
choices.why: decline 离 which 远，而且“下降被夸大”和 rather than 的对比对不上。

choices.label: which = weaker demand；主句否认有下降
choices.why: 主句承认有 decline，只是改原因。

choices.label: which 没有先行词，只是语气词
choices.why: 这类 which 几乎总有名词先行词。

items.text: Many graduates still lack access to reliable career advice, even though universities maintain that such support is already substantial.
items.prompt: even though 前后两层各说什么？

choices.label: 前：毕业生仍得不到可靠建议；后：校方坚称支持已经够多
choices.why: even though 让步：承认校方说法存在，但不取消前半句的事实。

choices.label: 前：毕业生拒绝建议；后：校方承认支持不够
choices.why: lack access 不是拒绝；maintain that … is substantial 是坚称够，不是承认不够。

choices.label: 两层在说同一件事，后半只是换词
choices.why: 前后立场相反，是让步，不是换述。

choices.label: substantial 在这里是“固体的”，与建议无关
choices.why: support is substantial = 支持的分量够。

items.text: A different picture emerges when we look at older workers: they are less likely to change jobs, even when pay is low.
items.prompt: they 指谁？冒号后面和前面是什么关系？

choices.label: they = older workers；冒号后具体说明“另一幅图景”
choices.why: 最近的复数名词是 older workers；冒号常用来展开 picture。

choices.label: they = jobs；冒号表示转折反对前句
choices.why: jobs 不是人，不能 they are less likely to change jobs。

choices.label: they = we；冒号引出作者自己的经历
choices.why: we 是观察者，不是被描述的工人。

choices.label: they 泛指年轻人
choices.why: when we look at older workers 已经限定对象。

items.text: Age remains a significant factor in who gets promoted; nevertheless, training can still open doors that seniority alone cannot.
items.prompt: 用自己的话，这句在主张什么？

choices.label: 年龄仍很要紧，但培训仍能打开资历打不开的门
choices.why: nevertheless 承认年龄重要，再补一条不被取消的出路。

choices.label: 年龄已经不重要，培训可以完全取代资历
choices.why: remains a significant factor 否定了“已经不重要”。

choices.label: 培训没有用，只有资历决定晋升
choices.why: 后半句明确说 training can still open doors。

choices.label: 作者在讨论医疗里的年龄因素
choices.why: who gets promoted 是职场晋升，不是医疗。
